open_items: ILO: chronic Cloudflare/WAF-shaped 403 pattern against ILO's direct (and sometimes gateway) path. Last occurrence was cycle 1438, flagged in the prior run as already recovered on live recheck. This run confirms the expected outcome: /api/history shows ILO healthy again from cycle 1439 through the current cycle 1441 (3 clean cycles), matching the prior run's prediction exactly, so not re-reported as a fresh incident. Full occurrence list through cycle 1438 (re-derived last run from /api/history?hours=240): 1320, 1323, 1327-1328, 1330, 1333, 1342-1345, 1354-1355, 1363, 1366, 1378, 1382, 1385, 1389-1390, 1392, 1414, 1438. Not a gateway code bug; nothing to fix. Keep watching for the next occurrence.
STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 1441 (reconfirmed by /api/contracts this run). Still open, not re-reported since no new change.
ILO encoding:structure_xml charset/version order flip seen again this run (cycle 1441), verdict stays ok; this is the known cosmetic flip, not an incident.
claude/ triage branches on origin: 161 as of this run (161 last run, unchanged), still well above the 20 the skill flags for pruning; not actioned by this read-only routine.

Monitor bug (standing): /api/history computes status without contracts, so a contract-only degraded state never shows up in /api/history, only in /api/status and /api/contracts. No contract-only degraded state occurred this run to re-confirm it, but the bug itself is unfixed.

Chronic gateway bug (empty 'Error: ' message from tools/sdmx_tools.py around lines 207-209 catching Exception with an empty str(e)): previously traced on ABS (many occurrences, most recently cycle 1403), ESTAT (cycles 1143, 1335, 1365, 1371, 1395, 1407), ECB (cycles 1337, 1339-adjacent, 1345, 1357, 1385-1386, 1388), and IMF (cycle 1368). No new occurrence this run (cycles 1439-1441 clean of this symptom across all endpoints). Still unfixed; recommend addressing the exception handler.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ECB does not support /availableconstraint/ (404 is expected, not an error); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); IMF direct json check is skipped by design (IMF ignores the JSON Accept header and returns XML); STATSNZ direct json check is skipped by design (Stats NZ ignores the JSON Accept header and returns CSV); BIS/IMF/ILO references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped); encoding:structure_xml charset/version order flips cosmetically from time to time, verdict stays ok.
